One doctor told me if she survived, she would live a “futile life.” She’s 5 years old now, going to kindergarten, rocking her wheelchair and feeding tube and charming the world with her toothy grin. Yes!!!!! Thank you!!!! People never talk about how abortion is so incredibly ableist and it’s so sad to me. Over 65% of babies with Down syndrome are aborted every year. The overwhelming majority of babies with limb differences are aborted, as well as babies with any heart or lung issues or any prenatally diagnosable disability. We are being murdered every day and nobody talks about it. Yes we may suffer in life, but everyone does!!! Nobody gets through this life without suffering. It’s not a “mercy” killing, it’s simply a killing. Disabled people live happy wonderful lives despite the awful things we face in this country to date. I firmly believe that disabled people are the only truly oppressed people in this country nowadays. Everyone else has their freedoms equal to everyone else, but disabled people can’t even get married in inter-able relationships without having our insurance taken away. Many disabled people cannot even get married period. We are put in homes if we have conservatorship and are abused in these homes. We are extremely underemployed, homeless, and are forgotten by the medical and psychiatric systems. We’re abused by both as well. When they find the genetic markers for Autism, I know that they will abort Autistic babies more than babies with Down syndrome. It terrifies me as an autistic woman that people see us as that awful of a people. They see us as a burden, a plague on society, worthless, useless, incapable of love or feeling or thought. This society deeply saddens me as a multiply disabled woman.
Helping disabled people thrive: Literally what an advanced society does
